variants.question: I'm a 20-year-old college student. What is the monthly maintenance fee for Everyday Checking, and how can it be waived?
variants.answer: The monthly maintenance fee for Everyday Checking is $12 [acc-everyday-checking#monthly-maintenance-fee]. variants.question: I'm a 20-year-old college student. How long do I have to dispute a card transaction?
variants.answer: To dispute a card transaction, open the transaction in the mobile app and select Dispute, or call 1-800-555-0100 [dispute-card-transactions#how-to-dispute]. You must dispute a card transaction within 60 days of the statement date on which the charge first appeared [dispute-card-transactions#dispute-deadline]. Meridian resolves most card disputes within 45 days [dispute-card-transactions#dispute-timeline].
facts_present: within 60 days of the statement date

response.answer: Applicants must be at least 18 years old, have a credit score of 660 or higher, and have a debt-to-income ratio below 40% to be eligible for a Meridian personal loan [loan-personal#eligibility]. Meridian Bank does not set an upper age limit for any loan product [loan-personal#eligibility]. Auto loan applicants need a credit score of 620 or higher to be eligible [loan-auto#eligibility].

retrieved.text: Applicants must be at least 18 years old, have a credit score of 660 or higher, and have a debt-to-income ratio below 40% to be eligible for a Meridian personal loan. Meridian Bank does not set an upper age limit for any loan product.
Auto loan applicants need a credit score of 620 or higher to be eligible. The vehicle must be no older than 10 years and have fewer than 125,000 miles.
Meridian personal loans have no origination fee. There is no prepayment penalty for paying off a personal loan early.
Personal loan APRs range from 7.49% to 19.99% based on credit history. Enrolling in autopay reduces the APR by 0.25 percentage points.
Personal loans range from $2,000 to $50,000. Repayment terms run from 12 to 72 months.
